package.description: Kensington Konnect™ optimizes your productivity with future-forward options, such as one-click access to AI tools like Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gemini to automate tasks, generate content, and streamline your workflow.

en-US.description: Kensington Konnect™ optimizes your productivity with future-forward options, such as one-click access to AI tools like Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gemini to automate tasks, generate content, and streamline your workflow.
en-US.longDescription: Keyboards should be customizable to enhance your productivity. Use Kensington Konnect™ software to streamline your workflow and automate repetitive tasks. Personalize your experience by programming keys and buttons. Assign a dedicated shortcut to launch your preferred AI application, create macros, adjust key mappings, manage profiles, and more—all at the click of a button.
en-US.name: Kensington Konnect™ (Keyboards)

zh-CN.description: Kensington Konnect™ 通过面向未来的选项优化您的工作效率，例如一键访问 Copilot、ChatGPT 和 Gemini 等 AI 工具，以实现任务自动化、内容生成并简化工作流程。
zh-CN.longDescription: 键盘应该可自定义，以提高工作效率。借助 Kensington Konnect™ 软件，一键定制视频会议控件、设定按键、创建宏、调整按键映射、管理配置文件等。
